definition_verified: Binary usual difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep; never/rarely or sometimes are controls.
time_window: Baseline questionnaire; variable symptoms: preceding 4 weeks.
limitation_or_human_question: Clinical chronic insomnia, impairment and night frequency are not required; controls can have occasional symptoms.

definition_verified: Integer hours slept per 24 hours, including naps.
time_window: Baseline; help text requests preceding 4-week daily average if variable.
limitation_or_human_question: Not nocturnal-only duration; primary GWAS excludes sleep medication and <3 or >18 hours.
Not <=5-hour extreme sleep; shared normal-sleep controls with long sleep.
Not >=10-hour extreme sleep; shared normal-sleep controls with short sleep.

definition_verified: Dichotomized morning preference versus evening preference; uncertain responses excluded.
limitation_or_human_question: This is the 403195-person UKB binary release, not full 697828-person meta-analysis or continuous chronotype; preference is not circadian phase.

definition_verified: Four ordered responses to unintended daytime dozing, analyzed numerically 1 to 4.
time_window: Baseline likelihood; no fixed recent-week window in question.
limitation_or_human_question: Ordinal single item, not Epworth score or nap frequency; all-the-time option removed during initial assessment.

definition_verified: Never/rarely, sometimes, usually: ordered categories analyzed numerically.
time_window: Baseline daytime behavior; preceding 4 weeks if variable.
limitation_or_human_question: Neither minutes of napping nor naps/week; exact source member is UKB no-BMI analysis, not 23andMe meta-analysis.

definition_verified: Participant reports whether a partner, relative or friend complains about snoring.
time_window: Baseline questionnaire without explicit frequency or recent-week window.
limitation_or_human_question: Participant is respondent; not a proxy respondent, clinical diagnosis, or quantified nightly frequency. Contact/awareness may affect classification.

definition_verified: Registry sleep-apnoea endpoint G47.3/3472; specified sleep-disorder exclusions in controls.
time_window: Recorded hospital/cause-of-death events; not contemporaneous sleep test.
limitation_or_human_question: Subtype, AHI and universal PSG confirmation are not in endpoint rule. Code-label and registry-display inconsistencies need Finnish review.

definition_verified: Summed detected sleep time / main sleep-window elapsed time.
Summed detected sleep episodes within main sleep window.
Mean midpoint of main sleep window.
limitation_or_human_question: Algorithm estimate; transformed effect, distinct from L5 timing.

definition_verified: Clinical EHR PheCode 327.4; not UKB frequency questionnaire.
time_window: Longitudinal VA records; precise GIA insomnia coding window and full ICD mapping require confirmation.
source_effect_units: log(odds_ratio), with standard-error scale validation pending
source_effect_allele: effect_allele, per source contract; not independently full-body validated
limitation_or_human_question: MVP HARE documentation defines >=2 mapped codes for cases and no codes for controls. Exact GIA/GCST rule, ICD map, observation window, single-code exclusion and sex mix need confirmation; no-code controls can have uncoded symptoms.
